FROM: E. D. MOWER - IGASS
DATE: December 19, 1952
TO: ALL IGA STEWARDESSES
CC: S. I. Mc Dermott - IGADPSM
J. J. Farmer - IGAADPSM
D. F. Magarrell - OPBTN
o. C. Enge - OPBSS
R. M. Wainwright - OPBSS

W. M. Stockan - OPBCY
SUBJECT: Fourth Quarterly Stewardess
Meetings - La Guardia
The fourth quarterly stewardess meetings were held on December 16, 17, and 18 at
9:00 A•M.
The first part of the meetings took place in the Conference Room of United's Hangar
#2 where thero was a general discussion and showing os emergency slides. Each girl
filled out the Stewardess Survey Questionnaire. Elaine Mower expounded on the in-
portance of the stewardesses on the plancs being seated with seat belts fastenod
before landings and take-offs.
The sccond part of the meeting consisted of morgency evacuation procedures from a
DC-6 in the hangar. Edith Lauterbach gavo a thorough discussion on emergency procod-
ures bofore the girls evacuated from the planc. All the girls jumped into the chute
first, then usod the oxit at seat 5A and slid down the wing. Edith Lautorbach then
actod as first stewardess with the girls as her passengers in an imaginary flight
roady to make an morgency landing. She rolayed the information to her passongers,
telling them what to do.
The girls acted accordingly before and during evacuation.
The actual evacuation of using two exits, 54 and the main cabin door was timed. The
girls did very well and learned much.
At 12:30 thoy proceeded to a private room in the terminal building where they were
served a Christnas luncheon.
Each girl took a rift from the grab-bag; pictures were
taken; corsages given out; and everyone ate lavishly.
Credit is due to Chef Salzmann who prepared the special lunch and Sam Iaquinto,
Supervisor of the Commissary, who decorated the room•
Our honored guests were Major V. Carson, Manager of La Guardia Airport, Lieutenant
Brady, head of the Port Authority Police Force, and George Marino, Safety Inspector.
We express our thanks and appreciation to Duggan Laird, CYSED, who assisted with the
emergency procedures.
Elaine D. Mower
